// The involute of a circle of radius Radius: the path of a taut string
// unwinding from the circle, over the unwinding-angle interval. The profile
// of standard gear teeth (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Involute).
type CircleInvolute2D
    implements ICurve2D
{
    Radius: Number;
    Angles: AngleInterval;
}
